services.name: Card RAM provisioning
services.detail: Dedicated verified payments and a segregated operator reserve; live qualification is separate.

services.name: Shared hosting subscriptions
services.detail: Paid capacity activates only after verified invoice settlement and an on-chain receipt. Live qualification is separate.

services.name: DAO merchant payments
services.detail: Each DAO owns its merchant account. Daclify Connect fees apply only to eligible card checkouts through this service.

services.name: Pinata / hosted storage
services.detail: Configured storage does not prove Pinata credentials or availability.

services.name: Guarded storage retention
services.detail: Operator-enabled cleanup requires separate live-provider qualification and complete pin/payment recovery. It never erases native identities, claims or purchased RAM.

services.name: Storage reminders
services.detail: Current administrator and paired email are checked before a period-bound reminder. Retries can duplicate an email; in-app notices remain available.

services.name: Storage operator alerts
services.detail: Scope-bound removal/recovery incidents notify the configured operator. Staged bytes remain protected; mail delivery needs separate qualification.

services.name: Prepaid pinned storage
services.detail: Separate monthly capacity with exact recurring approval; live qualification and cleanup are separate.

services.name: Card payments
services.detail: Verified Stripe webhooks attest card settlement; the configured settler is trusted.

services.name: Google sign-in
services.detail: Provider configuration only; live qualification is separate.

services.name: Telegram sign-in
services.detail: Provider configuration only; live qualification is separate.

services.name: Documentation assistant
services.detail: Optional assistant; generated documentation is always available.

services.name: Managed signing and recovery
services.detail: OpenBao remains a candidate. Production managed custody is not qualified.
